# Unit tests of route/tech. Owner: MZTECH (openspec/changes/m10-plot-route/design.md
# D3). Every *_test.cpp here is compiled into hefesto_route_tech_tests;
# extra libraries or definitions go below.

hefesto_add_area_tests(route_tech DATA_DIR route/tech)

# The branch-point tests include route/tech/detail.hpp (src/core/src).
target_include_directories(hefesto_route_tech_tests PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/core/src")

# Magic's scmos.tech, generated by tests/unit/tech when the reference tree
# build/ref/magic exists (tests skip otherwise).
target_compile_definitions(hefesto_route_tech_tests PRIVATE
  HEFESTO_SCMOS_TECH="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests/unit/tech/magic-tech/scmos.tech")
